name: switch
title: Switch
description: A native input-backed switch primitive for settings and product control panels. It includes minimal, elevated, segmented, and power visual variants, label and description copy, error state, disabled state, controlled/uncontrolled state, switch groups, and card-style setting rows.
author: Wensity <hello@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/switch.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add switch.
